newsitem.title: USA: Woodward Governor can't explain stock fall.
newsitem.headline: Woodward Governor can't explain stock fall.

text.p: Woodward Governor Co's stock fell sharply Wednesday, but the company, which posted a 23 percent rise in first-quarter earnings on Monday, said it was unaware of any news to account for the decline.

"I can assure you, the company's fundamentals have not changed," chief financial officer Stephen Carter told Reuters in a telephone interview. Woodward Governor was off 12 at 127 on volume of 4,600 shares.
Carter said the company continues to focus on long-term improvement, noting it would be "unrealistic" to expect 23 percent earnings growth each quarter.
"We've had situations where the company's stock has fluctuated. One day in November it rose 17-1/2 percent. I'm not sure of the cause," Carter said.
Woodward Governor manufactures fuel controls and governors for aircraft engines and its industrial division makes controls for diesel engines, locomotives and water power plants.
The company said it has no formal analyst coverage.
